professional_summary.content: Sabrina (chronological age: 10 months) was assessed using multiple standardized pediatric assessment tools, including the Bayley Scales of Infant and Toddler Development, Fourth Edition (Bayley-4), the Sensory Profile 2 (SP2), the Child Oral and Motor Proficiency Scale (ChOMPS), and the Pediatric Eating Assessment Tool (PEDI-EAT), to evaluate her developmental functioning across cognitive, motor, sensory processing, and communication domains. The comprehensive evaluation revealed both areas of emerging strength, such as her social engagement and learning potential, and areas requiring targeted intervention support, including fine motor coordination, attention and focus, communication skills, and behavioral regulation. Sabrina demonstrates delays that may impact her ability to participate fully in daily activities, suggesting a need for systematic intervention. Based on the assessment findings, occupational therapy services are recommended to facilitate her motor and communicative skills, mitigate behavioral regulation challenges, and enhance her attention span. A multidisciplinary, family-centered approach involving occupational therapy, speech-language therapy, and possibly early childhood education services will be beneficial to address Sabrina's comprehensive developmental needs. Regular monitoring and reassessment will be crucial to track progress, provide ongoing guidance to her family, and refine intervention strategies to promote her functional independence and developmental success. Engaging Sabrina's family in her therapeutic journey will enhance her progress by aligning home and therapeutic objectives, thereby maximizing her potential for growth and adaptation.
